nodes.label: SDD Execution Ledger
Pre-flight Conflict Scan
Ruling 4: Per-page Module Manifests Stay Separate
nodes.rationale: HOME_MODULES and SERVICES_MODULES coincide today but are independent per-page manifests; collapsing them would couple pages the spec treats as independent.

nodes.label: Ruling: Pin Next 15.5.26 over next@latest 16
nodes.rationale: Spec names Next 15; Next 16 defaults to Turbopack, an unknown twelve later tasks would inherit; no API in 16 helps this port.

nodes.label: Tailwind @source not Scan Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Excluding the multi-MB reference bundles and docs cut production build time from >120s to ~4-7s.

nodes.label: Negative Lengths Routed to Arbitrary Values
nodes.rationale: Prefix sign-flipping has no negative variant for p-/gap-/w-; arbitrary values like mt-[-8px] are always correct.

nodes.label: SIZE 100vw/100vh Keys Deleted
nodes.rationale: w-screen/h-screen hardcode an axis, so crossed axes emit a plausible wrong value that a visual diff could pass.

nodes.label: @ts-nocheck on Vendored liquid-ether.ts
nodes.rationale: Frozen fidelity-critical vendored code; minimising touched lines beats in-file diagnostics nobody will act on.

nodes.label: Discrimination (Mutation) Proof Requirement
nodes.rationale: Five specified tests were proven vacuous (string/regex checks); every test-bearing task must prove its test fails on the bug it guards.

nodes.label: Dead darks/onDark Computation Deleted from nav.ts
nodes.rationale: Never read in the home original and forced a layout reflow per scroll for zero visual effect; valid for nav.ts only, not studio/case-study.

nodes.label: AgRuntime modules Must Be a Stable Reference
nodes.rationale: Effect deps are [modules]; an inline array literal would tear down and remount every behaviour on each render.

nodes.label: Scoped ESLint Override for Two Vendored Files
nodes.rationale: Keeps ban-ts-comment/no-explicit-any enforced on project code while exempting only third-party vendored files; rejected ignoreDuringBuilds and global disables.

nodes.label: Per-cleanup try/catch Isolation in AgRuntime
nodes.rationale: The original componentWillUnmount wraps each cleanup; one throwing WebGL/GSAP disposer would otherwise silently leak every later one.

nodes.label: TypeScript-AST SSR Scope Check
nodes.rationale: The indentation heuristic was proven vacuous; the build could not catch hazards until pages import the modules; typescript is already a devDependency.

nodes.label: Suffix-agnostic Route Normalisation with Loud Failure
nodes.rationale: 82 of 96 internal links used a bare .html suffix; exact .dc.html matching would have shipped dead navigation on six of seven pages.

nodes.label: Converter Completeness Guard for Unknown style-*/sc-* and Custom Tags
nodes.rationale: The third unnamed pattern slipped through silently; a guard turns any future surprise into a conversion-time failure.

nodes.label: No Shared Nav/MenuOverlay/Footer Components
nodes.rationale: 4-5 genuinely divergent variants per region; a props API would parameterise everything - five implementations behind one interface.

nodes.label: Optional News Panel in shell.ts
nodes.rationale: Careers has no news panel, so guarding on !ov||!news||!menu would drop its menu entirely.

nodes.label: ContactPill Mounted Per Page
nodes.rationale: The original loaded the pill per document so its drop-in animation replayed per visit; a persistent layout mount would never replay.

nodes.label: Per-page Client Runtime Wrapper
nodes.rationale: A Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component; whole-page use client ships ~84KB for nothing; a central map would drag three.js into pages that never use it.

nodes.label: ext_resources Poster Mapping Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The unbundler ignored __bundler/ext_resources so video-reel posters had no mapping; fixed in the tooling chain so video.ts stays byte-faithful.

nodes.label: fanPointer Behaviour Deleted as Dead Code
Ruling: Defer and Batch Visual Gates (Chrome Unavailable)
nodes.rationale: Every fidelity defect so far was caught by tooling; the fix-the-converter-and-regenerate architecture makes late discovery a re-run. Mitigation: no hand-tuning of converter output.

nodes.label: Converter Emits next/link for Resolved Internal Routes
nodes.rationale: Plain <a> means full reloads, voiding AgRuntime disposal, the scroll-lock reset and per-page ContactPill; <Link> renders an identical <a>.

nodes.label: navCareers Verbatim Port (Inline Style vs :hover)
nodes.rationale: Shared nav.ts writes an inline background that beats careers' hover:bg class; "same value" is not "no effect". A verbatim port needs no composition proof.

nodes.label: Four Nav Families Across Seven Pages
Three Distinct Form Success Messages
makeForm(message) Factory
nodes.rationale: Form variants differ in one string; parameterising a datum is not parameterising behaviour. Called at module scope so references stay stable.

nodes.label: Playwright Fidelity Harness Replacing Chrome Gate
Root Cause 1: Archivo Static Instances Disable wdth Axis
Root Cause 2: Ambiguous font-[...] Utility Compiles to font-weight
Root Cause 3: next/font Hashed Family Names Never Match Markup
Root Cause 4: Tailwind Preflight line-height 1.5 on html
nodes.rationale: Restored line-height: normal on html rather than disabling Preflight, because border utilities depend on Preflight's border-style.

nodes.label: Root Cause 5: Unlayered Form-Control Reset Outranks Utilities
nodes.rationale: Deleted rather than wrapped in @layer base since Preflight already provides the same reset inside a layer.

nodes.label: Ruling: Reverse next/font, Self-host Original WOFF2
nodes.rationale: next/font produced three separate typography defects; the exact design is defined by the original files with their unicode-range subsetting.

nodes.label: Verify-One-Level-Down Trap (Synthetic vs Real Elements)
nodes.rationale: The wdth proof measured a test element, proving the font supports the axis, not that the page uses the font; font proofs must use real page elements.

nodes.label: Ruling: Continue Past Five-Round Fix Cap
nodes.rationale: The cap catches non-converging loops; 27->26->24->14 was convergent, each round isolating a distinct root cause.

nodes.label: Stray Server and Stale Build Contamination Incidents
Static-Analysis Mobile Predictions Mostly Wrong
nodes.rationale: 5 of 7 predicted breakages measured clean, including the marquee ribbons; measurement was decisive every time.

nodes.label: Careers CTA Tap-target Deferral (items-baseline Rejected)
nodes.rationale: max-lg:py-3 degraded glyph-level alignment by ~9px; items-baseline aligns the first baseline of a multi-line paragraph and is plausibly worse.

nodes.label: ContactPill Overlays Form at 390 (Deferred Design Decision)
Stale Asset-Parity Test After Font Self-hosting
nodes.rationale: "Pre-existing and unrelated" is a claim, not an exemption; a test count that moves is a finding.

nodes.label: Ignore .source/** in ESLint
Final Whole-Branch Review
Regenerate-and-Repaste Maintainer Trap
Ruling: Close Contact Background Loophole Despite One-Wave Rule
nodes.rationale: A one-line tool change closing exactly the failure mode the wave was commissioned for; handing the user a known oracle hole to save one dispatch is the wrong trade.
